# The events the engine fires itself (`coverage::events`), and the modules
# that fire them: every event the engine's code names but to compare it, and
# the events of the recordings the login replays. A test fires the others
# with `mock.fireEvent`. Generated from the code by the test
# `coverage::tests::the_fired_events_follow_the_code`
# (`WOWLUA_FIRED_EVENTS_WRITE=1 cargo test -p wowlua-engine fired_events`
# writes it). Do not edit.
